text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh... That was truly edge-of-your-seat excitement.
"Prifight VS Spy Cats"...
Hard to believe it's just an anime."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~?!
Those Spy Cats are pretty impressive, aren't they!
Scouting ahead and mastering PreFigh's techniques and all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scout them out, and their techniques...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, time to run~! I'll show you Lord Teio's Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
Teio-san is bouncing around today as usual.
I wonder if her ankles are made of springs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If Mar-chan copies that too,
maybe Mar-chan will become even more lovely?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your acceleration is lacking. Open up your stride more.
Let me show you—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san takes huge strides.
Looks like she might take flight someday.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If Chan could fly through the sky,
Chan would probably become quite popular.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was training with Aston Machan as usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ahem.
Starting today, Chan is "New Chan,"
or just "Chan" for short.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please remember me from now on~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason is unknown, but
Aston Machan's running has suddenly improved.
We can look forward to great performances from her moving forward!
